own_solution.law: Closed-open air column resonance: L + e = (2n+1) lambda/4, so successive resonant lengths differ by lambda/2 = v/(2f); time = (lambda/2)/(level speed)
assumptions: level falls at constant speed 1.5 cm/s

notes: lambda = 343/512 = 0.66992 m; lambda/2 = 0.33496 m; t = 0.33496/0.015 = 22.33 s. With a second tube tap open (rates additive per 'alone draws down'), speed 2.4 cm/s -> 13.96 s. Initial column length 130 cm fixes when the first resonance occurs (resonant lengths 0.1675(2n+1) m - e) but cancels from the spacing; the tube being 'tall' ensures further resonances. Pond and earlier-run taps are disconnected. T3D7A and TB8E5 say 'a steady rate' rather than 0.9 cm/s (numeral-free variants). Numbers consistent across variants (0.9 cm/s, 130 cm).
